strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Ah, there's a ton of those guys!
Which means the Death Army might be here too?
Yeah, and my master... Master Asia... is probably here too.
Tch, I'd rather not think it, but... Akira, were they behind Jaburo...?
Yeah, no doubt about it... Mister.
... I have a really bad feeling about this...
Not Zeon, not the aliens targeting Earth...
Why would a totally unknown army go after Jaburo...?
Commander Hazuki, won't they answer our hails?
...I've been trying this whole time.
But... rather than ignoring us, perhaps those machines simply have no comms.
That may be the truth of it.
But that Alchemie person's machine,
seemed to have comms...
That's right, the red one did contact us.
Maybe it's just them bony machines that ain't got comms?
No, those bone-like enemies...
those Einst Knochen... might be closer to Fossil Beasts...
Mechanical Beasts can't talk either, right? Don't sweat it, Commander.
If we smash 'em all, the mastermind'll show up eventually!
"Don't smash them all, please," right?
Oh, you get it, Sayaka.
I know what you're thinking, at least, Koji.
True, there's no talking to Mechanical Beasts or Mykene's Battle Beasts.
The Mykene are practically half living creatures.
True. Clashing without a word is unsettling in its own way, though...
Let's get this started! Dithering around won't get us anywhere.
Yeah, it'd be no fun if more aliens butted in...
That's the idea.
It's decided, then. Now, let's do this!
The Death Army!?
The Death Series Kasshu is chasing, appearing with the unknown enemy...
What does this mean?
Commander, this unknown enemy, like the Death Series,
may have been created by the Devil Gundam.
Hmm... That's possible.
(The Devil Gundam...? ...No, that's not it...!)
If the Death Army's here, could the Devil Gundam be nearby too!?
Domon!
...And the Master, too.
Come out, you fake! You're not my master... You're not Master Asia!
What are you saying!?
Save such foolish drivel until you can lay so much as a finger on me!
(If I pour every technique I've mastered, and my entire soul,
into this fist and strike with it, Master will surely understand!)
Domon!
Master... On my name as the King of Hearts!
Fight me!
Interesting! I accept your challenge!
Ooooh! Gundam Fiiiiight!
Readyyyyy!
Gooooooo!
Fuhahahaha, it seems the time has come...
What!?
Fuhahahaha, it's too late!
Now, behold the form of my king and reconsider!
And walk alongside me, Domon!
Th-that's...!
So that's the Devil Gundam...!
So magnificent it leaves you speechless?
That's right! Unlike the others, I am not being controlled.
Enthralled by the Devil Gundam's power, I chose to serve it myself!
N-no way...!?
Brother?
That man is Domon's brother?
Brother... Why...?
Domon... If you will not come with us, so be it...
It's time I finished you off!
I won't allow it!
Hm!?
Fuhahahaha, Master Asia, you won't have your way!
What!?
Hmm, no matter. One more small fry makes no difference!
Take this!
He split into copies!? He's good! Who are you?
My name is Schwarz Bruder of Neo Germany.
Remember it well!
So that's Neo Germany's Mobile Fighter, Gundam Spiegel...
...Brother...!
What are you doing, Domon!? Hurry! Destroy the Devil Gundam now!
But who are you...?
That doesn't matter. Hurry!
Domon! You came to Earth to defeat the Devil Gundam... Kyoji, right?
Then do it!
Th-that's right, it's this thing... Because of this thing...
Because of this thing, Mother and Father...
Because of this thiiing!!
Brother...!
You fool, why did you pull off the head!?
The Shining Finger's power is being absorbed...!?
What just happened?
Looks like things just got complicated.
Behold this form!
Thanks to that power of yours, my Devil Gundam is fully revived.
You have my thanks! Guhahaha...
Autonomous metal cells... I never imagined they were this powerful...!
What now? Taking that thing on in our current state looks pretty rough.
Guhahaha, rest easy. I won't show you the Devil Gundam's power just yet.
Running away?
But know that the next time we meet will be your end...
Until then, reflect on your own immaturity, Domon.
Farewell, Domon. King of Hearts, guhahahaha.
W-wait. Please wait! Master, Brother! Brother... Brotheeeer!
Domon's brain waves are dropping...!
Dr. Hazuki, please retrieve the Shining Gundam!
Kasshu has been retrieved. Everyone, mop up the remaining enemies.
Who goes there!!
Tobikage...!
The Ninja Warrior has arrived!
I figured it'd be showing up about now.
We're counting on you! Tobikage!
I'll defeat Master Asia with my own hands!
Whew, looks like that's everything taken care of...
Though the Devil Gundam got away...
How do you know about the Devil Gundam?
I can't go into detail now, but I'll say only this: I too am pursuing
the Devil Gundam...
Ah, he's gone...
Schwarz Bruder... Who in the world is he...?
There were so many things I wanted to ask...
Princess, let us save that for another time.
Anyway, let's focus on storming into Jaburo for now.
Sure, the Devil Gundam and that Schwarz guy bother me too, but...
No, before that, I'd like you to recover the mystery enemy's wreckage.
What do you want with wreckage?
If we have time for that, shouldn't we just storm in already?
We have almost no information on that mysterious enemy.
Examining the wreckage may tell us something.
True, might be smart to gather some intel on our enemy about now.
All units, return to the Gandor, and once resupplied,
head out to recover the wreckage. Captain, lead the recovery team.
Understood.
